title.text: workharbor: web UI and whr CLI mock, with example data

phone.text: Phone view puts decisions first. Answering from the phone resumes the agent. Medium term this becomes an installable PWA with Web Push.

cli.text: Every action in the web UI has a whr command. Exit code 6 means a task needs human input.

push.text: ntfy push: task ID, event kind and a link only. Never issue text or code, and no approve button. Approvals stay behind your login.

v0.text: Marked after v0: pause and take over, open in editor, new task and cancel in the UI. In v0 the web UI only answers Decisions.

login.text: New: auth_expired shows as a blocking Decision. The run pauses, the workspace and session are kept, and you log in again from the UI.

onboarding.text: First-run wizard: sign in, connect the forge, choose subscription or API key, check the host (unverified items are marked), set up ntfy.
